entities.name: Reflective QoS
entities.description: A quality of service mechanism where the UE applies QoS rules derived from downlink user plane traffic.

entities.name: QoS Rule
entities.description: Rules derived by the UE from downlink traffic patterns to apply QoS treatment to uplink traffic.

entities.name: Downlink Traffic
entities.description: User plane traffic received by the UE from the network.

entities.name: Uplink Traffic
entities.description: User plane traffic sent by the UE to the network.

relations.description: Reflective QoS procedure is triggered by downlink user plane traffic.
Reflective QoS procedure establishes QoS rules based on downlink traffic patterns.
QoS rules derived from reflective QoS are applied to uplink traffic.
